correctness.rationale: Exact Kummer-to-carry equivalence for n+3n; a six-state transfer with correct terminal carry is derived, and exact matrix inversion yields D(t,z) and numerator. Differentiation and partial fractions give all-depth moments, a three-state maximal-path transfer gives a cubic recurrence, and primitive Perron spectral perturbation proves Gaussian convergence. A separately runnable standard-library checker verifies 29824 precise finite identities; finite tests are not substituted for the infinite argument.
